_comment: S-4 / 7.1 expiry_risks_mixed.json. The four required contrasts: Best By passed (reassure), Use By tomorrow (firm), Sell By passed (suppressed regardless), estimated low-confidence (flagged). item_id values match pantry_state_demo.json.

items.name: Greek Yogurt
items.guidance: Still good to eat — Best Before is a quality date, not a safety date.
items.explanation: 2 days past best_by. Quality may have softened slightly; there is no safety concern. Reassure, and suggest a rescue recipe.

items.name: Sliced Turkey
items.guidance: Use today or tomorrow, or discard. Do not rely on smell alone.
items.explanation: Use By tomorrow on a high_risk deli item. Firm warning, no reassurance framing, and not eligible for donation.

items.name: Whole Milk
items.guidance: No action needed. This date is for store restocking, not you.
items.explanation: Sell By is a retailer rotation date, not a consumer deadline. Suppressed from alerts entirely regardless of how many days have passed.

items.name: Baby Spinach
items.guidance: Check for wilting or sliminess before using — this date is our best guess, not a read label.
items.explanation: No printed date was read; this is inferred from category shelf life at low confidence. Flagged visibly as an estimate.
